turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment metric, so I cannot give a rate for 20 September to 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are Cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on that day or the day after) and Cart sessions, and I have not computed any figure for this period.
